name: gauge-kit
title: Composable gauge
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Composable SVG gauge primitives: track, arc, stack, zones, ticks, marks, labels, needle, hub, dot, and value, with spring or tween motion, nested dials, and a keyboard slider.

export { useGaugeControllers } from "@/hooks/use-gauge-controllers"
export { useStoredValue } from "@/hooks/use-stored-value"

/** Adapted from Gauge UI (MIT). https://github.com/thordursk/gauge-ui */

import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react"

import { readStored, subscribeStored } from "@/lib/gauge-kit/storage"

/**
 * The value stored under `key`, or `fallback` where there is none. The server
 * and the hydration pass are given the fallback, as they must be, and the
 * stored value arrives in the render right after; a write from anywhere —
 * this tab or another — brings every reader of the key along with it.
 */
export const useStoredValue = (key: string, fallback: string) =>
  useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribeStored,
    () => readStored(key) ?? fallback,
    () => fallback
  )

api.name: startAngle / endAngle
api.description: Sweep in degrees, clockwise from six o'clock.

api.name: label
api.description: Accessible name. The root is role=meter with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax.

api.name: transition
api.description: true uses a spring. Or { type: "spring", visualDuration, bounce } or { type: "tween", duration, ease }. Snaps when prefers-reduced-motion is set.

api.name: wrap / rotate
api.description: wrap follows the short way around a circular domain. rotate turns the scale under a fixed pointer.

api.name: children
api.type: GaugeTrack, GaugeArc, GaugeStack, GaugeZones, GaugeTicks, GaugeMarks, GaugeTickLabels, GaugeNeedle, GaugeHub, GaugeDot, GaugeValue, GaugeText, GaugeInset
api.description: Parts read the value from context and can be reordered.

api.name: GaugeControl
api.description: Drag the ring, or turn the face with knob. Arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Home and End. Enter or Space calls onPress.

api.name: className
api.description: Root class. Width follows the parent.

docs: Adapted from Gauge UI by Thordur (MIT): https://github.com/thordursk/gauge-ui. See NOTICE. The catalog item named gauge stays the Arc filled arc and is not replaced. Import the kit from the installed gauge-kit folder. font "rounded" uses the host sans; the item ships no typeface, hex, or cssVars. Motion snaps when the reader prefers reduced motion. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
